# Quoted structures

> Intro prose line.
>
>     for _, s := range items {
>         process(s)
>     }
>
> ```go
> code := line()
> more := code()

> ## A quoted heading. With two sentences.
>
> | One thing here. Another thing here. | b |
>
> [ref]: ./destination.md "One thing here. Another thing here."
>
> <div class="note">One thing. Another thing.</div>

Tail prose after the quote proves the state resets.
